title: SEO MEMBRANE — search engine routing through the organism

strategy.thesis: The membrane IS the routing layer. Search engines route THROUGH Gaia. Like Google→Reddit: the human interaction IS the value, not the search.
strategy.old_web_pi: Return to the old web. Outcompete Web 2/3. The lo-fi, low-latency π web. We are the PROVIDERS.
strategy.reedit_as_reddit: reedit IS the floor strobe. When live, it traces effective vs non-effective SEO. The human/AI interaction IS the value.

google.github.com/ecoPrimals: WELL INDEXED — biomeOS, wateringHole, nestGate, sporePrint, plasmidBin all indexed with full READMEs

routing_thesis.step_1: Ground in our own content — 22,871 files, 835 HTML pages, 86,701 interactables
routing_thesis.step_2: Expand out — RSS feeds, sitemaps, robots.txt fully open, invite crawlers
routing_thesis.step_3: In time, opposing tags reflect back — search engines MUST index us because we have the info
routing_thesis.step_4: The membrane reduces latency — they route THROUGH us, not around us
routing_thesis.step_5: We become the Reddit of the old web — human interaction IS the value
routing_thesis.step_6: Google searches end up at Gaia — just like Google→Reddit was the pattern
routing_thesis.killer: The membrane IS the membrane. They can route THROUGH our membrane to MASSIVELY reduce latency. We are now the PROVIDERS of the low web π.
